# Amr: context sheets for ChatGPT

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-mascot-context-brief.mjs from context-sheets.json. Edit the JSON, then run the script. -->

Fifty-five more sheets of Amr (S11–S115), drawn with **ChatGPT image generation** like [the first ten](AMR-ART-BRIEF.md). They let him react to the weather where the visitor is, the visitor's time of day, Egyptian, Islamic, Coptic and international days by Cairo's calendar, the seasons, the toolkit's own moments and play. Each sheet is one image of 8 poses, slot 1 his standard stance, exactly like S01–S10.

The site switches each scene on only once its sheet has come back and been built into a pack, so the sheets can come back a few at a time, in any order.

## How to run a sheet

1. Settings, as before: **1536 × 1024**, **transparent background**, **PNG**, **high** quality, one image per request.
2. Attach the references from [`reference/`](reference/): `ref-1-stance.png`, `ref-hair.png`, `ref-2-detail.png`, `ref-3-range.png`, and your approved `S01-faces.png` as the fourth reference (ref-4).
3. Paste the [master block](AMR-ART-BRIEF.md#2-master-block), then the [context rules](#context-rules), then the sheet's block. The prompt page has one button that copies all three.
4. Check the sheet against [the checklist](AMR-ART-BRIEF.md#5-check-every-sheet-before-you-keep-it). Props are allowed on these sheets, but only the ones the sheet names.
5. Save it under its file name (`S11-sun.png` and so on) in the same folder as S01–S10.

Start a new ChatGPT conversation every eight sheets or so, with the references attached again, so he doesn't drift. To fix one slot, ask for an edit of the same image: _"Keep the other slots exactly as they are. Redraw only slot 6: …"_. If the transparent background fails, use the magenta fallback from the main brief.

## Suggested order

**Every day: the weather and the hour.** These play on any day, so they make the biggest difference first.

S11 Sunny day · S12 Hot day · S13 Scorching day · S14 Cold day · S15 Cosy with a scarf and tea · S16 Rainy day · S17 Heavy rain · S18 Thunderstorm · S19 Snow · S20 Windy day · S21 Fog and grey skies · S22 Clear night · S23 Khamaseen dust · S24 Morning coffee · S25 Ful and ta'meya breakfast · S26 Koshary lunch · S27 End of the workday · S28 Late night · S29 Weekend

**Coming up, in date order.** From November 2026: winter, Christmas and New Year, Isra and Mi'raj (5 January 2027), 25 January, Valentine's Day, Ramadan (from about 8 February), Eid al-Fitr (about 9 March), Mother's Day, Pi Day and April Fools, Earth Day, Coptic Easter and Sham el-Nessim (2 and 3 May), Labour Day, Eid al-Adha (about 16 May), summer, the Mawlid (about 14 August), Nayrouz, back to school and Halloween.

S53 Sahlab and sweet potato · S39 Christmas · S45 New Year · S44 Watching fireworks · S37 Blessed days · S43 Egyptian flag · S46 Flowers day · S30 Ramadan lantern · S31 Iftar at sunset · S32 Suhoor before dawn · S33 Konafa and qatayef · S34 Eid kahk · S35 Eid day · S49 April Fools and Pi Day · S47 Green day · S40 Coloured eggs · S41 Sham el-Nessim picnic · S50 Labour Day and Teachers' Day · S36 Eid al-Adha · S51 Summer holiday · S38 Mawlid sweets · S42 Nayrouz · S52 Back to school · S48 Spooky week

## Context rules

Paste this after the master block, unchanged.

```text
CONTEXT SHEETS (S11 and later). These sheets give Amr a prop or a moment from the weather, the time of day, a holiday, a season or his work.
- The sheet text describes each prop once. Draw that same prop, the same size and colours, in every slot that uses it. Props are simple, solid, slightly toy-like objects with clean shapes and bold colours, big enough to read when he is 100 pixels tall. A prop stays inside his slot and never hides his face unless a slot says so.
- His clothes never change: no coats, jackets, costumes or hats unless a slot asks for one, and then it goes over his usual clothes. Wherever his hair shows, it is exactly the haircut in ref-hair.
- Draw no weather and no effects: no rain, raindrops, puddles, snow, snowflakes, wind lines, sun rays, steam, smoke, sparks, sparkles, confetti, fireworks, light beams or musical notes. The website adds those. Act the weather and the moment with his body and face.
- No writing, letters or numbers on any prop. No other people and no animals; a toy only where a slot asks for one.
- Food and drink are always held in his hand, never floating, unless a slot says it was just tossed.
```

### Weather where the visitor is

#### S11 — Sunny day

`S11-sun.png` · Clear or mainly clear sky in the daytime where the visitor is, under 32 °C feels-like

```text
SHEET S11 — SUNNY DAY. Prop: a pair of black sunglasses with a thin black frame.
1. The standard stance, exactly as in ref-1.
2. Holding the folded sunglasses up in one hand, squinting up at the bright sky with a happy smile.
3. Putting the sunglasses on with both hands at his temples, grinning.
4. Sunglasses on, arms folded across his chest, chin up, a cool confident smile.
5. Sunglasses on, face turned up to the sky, arms a little out from his sides with palms forward, soaking up the sun with a blissful smile.
6. No sunglasses: they are folded and hooked in his open collar. One hand held flat above his eyes like a visor, looking far into the distance, squinting.
7. Sunglasses on, a big thumbs-up toward us with a wide smile.
8. Sliding the sunglasses down his nose with one finger, peeking over them at us with raised eyebrows.
```

7. Hanging by both hands from an invisible bar above his head: arms straight up, body stretched, legs dangling and bent at the knees, looking down past his feet, alarmed.
8. Standing steady again, feet a little apart, one hand flat on his chest, cheeks puffed as he breathes out, eyes half closed, relieved.

## Hand back

Put the keepers next to S01–S10 in one folder (or a zip) and share it. Claude runs `python -I scripts/build-mascot-packs.py <folder> --preview <scratch>`: every context sheet present becomes a pack, its heads are matched to the live sprite like the first ten, and its scenes switch on.
